notes: chi(cat_8) >= 3 by monotonicity from chi(cat_5) > 2 (Qassim, Pashayan, and Gosset, arXiv:2106.07740, appendix: <0|_m |cat_m> is proportional to |cat_{m-1}>, so chi(cat_m) >= chi(cat_{m-1}) for all m). Their Table 1 lists chi(cat_8) <= 6 and no lower bound beyond this. The board's attested chi(H^8) >= 6 gives the same 3 through chi(T^m)/2 <= chi(cat_m). Cited.
